topic: What if Zoro never solved Mihawk's riddle against Sommers
title: What If Zoro Never Remembered Mihawk's Lesson?
description: What if Zoro never remembered Mihawk's lesson in his fight with Shepherd Sommers? Without Supreme King Haki, a Knight of God can't die, and Elbaph loses its best swordsman at the worst moment. Who stops Imu now?
comment: Without Zoro, does Elbaph fall to Imu, or does Sanji step up? Pick one.

lines.text: What if Zoro never remembered Mihawk's lesson in the middle of his fight with Sommers?

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman facing a smiling knight

lines.text: What if the Knight of God just kept healing, cut after cut, until Zoro ran out of strength?

shot.fallback: wounds closing on an armored knight

lines.text: And with Zoro stuck in a fight he can't finish, who stops Imu on Elbaph?

shot.fallback: shadowy figure controlling a girl with glowing eyes

lines.text: To understand how everything changes, we have to go back to the start of chapter 1193.

shot.fallback: two swordsmen clash in a giant village

lines.text: Shepherd Sommers is a Knight of God, and Knights of God don't die the way normal fighters do.
Every wound Zoro gives him closes in seconds, as if the blade never touched him.
In the real story, Zoro remembers Mihawk's words and coats all three swords in Supreme King Haki.

shot.fallback: swordsman with three swords wrapped in black lightning

lines.text: But in this version, that memory never comes back.
[...the story continues: 100-260 lines in total, 5-8 chapters, a card about once a minute...]

shot.fallback: giant village under a stormy sky

lines.text: So the strongest swordsman on the crew ends the arc still swinging at a man who can't die.
Was Mihawk's lesson the only thing standing between Elbaph and Imu? Tell me which side you're on.
And if you want to see what happens if Sanji gets Supreme King Haki first, that's the next story.

self_check.hook: What If question + two escalating questions in the first 15 s
self_check.loop: chapter endings leave an open question
